dependency: Task 177 output, port 8012 visibility match and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 179 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Existing points remain search anchors only.

features.name: 2 Willow Road
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies 2 Willow Road as the 1939 Modernist home of Erno Goldfinger at Hampstead, London NW3 1TH.
features.classification_finding: The tracked Detached Home label conflicts with published building descriptions identifying 2 Willow Road as the middle house in a terrace of three. Do not preserve Detached Home without a documented category policy decision.

features.name: DP World London Gateway Logistics Park
features.official_source_evidence: DP World presents London Gateway as an economic zone and logistics park supporting warehouse, distribution, manufacturing and storage facilities.
features.classification_finding: The park is a multi-building logistics estate, not one Industrial Unit. A specific building must be selected before binding an Industrial Unit geometry.

features.name: Harrods Knightsbridge
features.official_source_evidence: Harrods' official visit guide identifies the Knightsbridge store and its retail visitor functions; the tracked address context is 87-135 Brompton Road, London SW1X 7XL.
features.classification_finding: Primary retailer evidence strongly supports Retail Property. Exact building and parcel boundary remain pending.

features.name: 20 Fenchurch Street
features.official_source_evidence: The current public Sky Garden service is associated with 20 Fenchurch Street. The previously tracked official-building domain redirected to unrelated content during the 2026-07-13 verification pass and must not be used as trusted evidence.
features.classification_finding: Authoritative published building records support office use, but the compromised or expired prior domain must be removed from the trusted source set.

features.name: Wardian London
features.official_source_evidence: Wardian London is consistently identified as an EcoWorld-Ballymore residential development consisting of two residential towers at Marsh Wall.
features.classification_finding: Developer identity supports Apartment Building, while a bounded current source snapshot and exact tower footprints remain pending.

features.name: Magna Park Lutterworth
features.official_source_evidence: Magna Park Lutterworth is an established warehousing and logistics park containing multiple distribution buildings.
features.classification_finding: The whole park cannot be treated as one Industrial Unit. A specific warehouse or unit must be selected and verified before geometry binding.
